articles.title: Haze update Oct 17: Rain keeps air quality from worsening, 24-hour PSI forecast unhealthy to very unhealthy
articles.content: Afternoon showers over parts of Singapore helped keep hourly PM2.5 from climbing into the very high band on Saturday (Oct 17) afternoon. It then hit a high of 243µg/m3 at 2pm, before thundery showers possibly kept it from crossing into very high band (>251µg/m3). Elsewhere, PM2.5 is in the elevated band in the eastern (139µg/m3) and northern (106µg/m3) regions
